# Valet Auto Leasing

> A no-fee new-car buying and leasing service for New York City (all five boroughs), Long Island (Nassau and Suffolk), Westchester and New Jersey. We find, negotiate and deliver new cars so customers never visit a dealership. The dealer pays us; customers pay nothing. A division of All State Auto Leasing & Finance (10+ years of dealer relationships).

- Phone: (917) 301-9046
- New cars only, lease or buy, roughly $25,000 to $250,000 (Camry to Bentley). Used cars are accepted only as trade-ins.
- Free Deal Check: send a dealer quote; a trained person reviews it within one business day and tells you to take it if we can't beat it.
- Trade-in equity check, lease-end options review, door-to-door delivery.
- Referral program (Valet Partners): $150 per referred friend who closes a deal.
